scope: Seven selected real registered-terrain battle cases, canonical Achilles classic E orientation, legal precombat purchase/equip fixture, three-cell walk then one shot. Not a full run or campaign completion, not all 42 spell IDs in combat, not a four-direction visual audit.

selection.policy: First five passing cases of expedition_bows_final, plus passing Givre rerun and Foudre batch. The earlier Givre failure is retained below and not counted as a pass.

timing_contract.measurement_note: Configured scheduler delay and observed event intervals are reported separately. OS/frame scheduling and observer work may change measured wall-clock intervals; no exact 200 ms wall-clock claim.

givre_probe_correction.reason: The first probe incorrectly required Achilles as a scoped status source. The actual Spell has status_source_scoped=false and correctly stores no source instance. The corrected probe checks the same target, absence before, presence after, mp_reduction=1, remaining=1 and source_instance_id=0, before an enemy turn.
